preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10.
The values of N, M, and Q are between 1 and 10^5.
The x-coordinate of the query is between 1 and N.
The y-coordinate of the query is between 1 and M.

preconditions.expression: The sum of (N + M + Q) over all test cases does not exceed 10^6
preconditions.description: The total sum of N, M, and Q across all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: The output is a string of length Q
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string corresponds to the winner of a query, where '1' indicates Alice wins and '0' indicates Bob wins.
